status.reason: this stream declares sampling post_invocation but reads driver RAM out of band after the emulated frame advances, so a frame whose driver work overruns it records a strict prefix of zUpdateMusic's track-iteration order, truncated at a varying point. Movie frame 252, the title-music load, is such a frame; it is what stalled the oracle at tick 138.
